assertions.description: The Profiler global exists and is a function (the base JS Self-Profiling API, shipped in Chromium 94, on which markers build).
Profiler.prototype carries stop(), sampleInterval and stopped, and inherits from EventTarget (for the samplebufferfull event).
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof Profiler !== 'function') return false; const p = Profiler.prototype; return typeof p.stop === 'function' && 'sampleInterval' in p && 'stopped' in p && Object.getPrototypeOf(p) === EventTarget.prototype; })()

assertions.description: On a document that IS served with Document-Policy: js-profiling (this site serves the header on every path under the v147 js-profiling-in-dedicated-workers feature), the constructor succeeds and stop() resolves a trie-shaped trace: frames/stacks/samples arrays, numeric sample timestamps, and every stackId indexing into stacks. Runs the real constructor inside a hidden same-origin iframe on a policy-enabled, script-free document so the check stays free of console/network noise.
assertions.test: (async () => { const iframe = document.createElement('iframe'); iframe.style.display = 'none'; iframe.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); iframe.src = '/v147/js-profiling-in-dedicated-workers/conformance.json'; document.body.append(iframe); try { await new Promise((res, rej) => { iframe.onload = res; iframe.onerror = () => rej(new Error('policy-enabled iframe failed to load')); setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('policy-enabled iframe timeout')), 8000); }); const W = iframe.contentWindow; if (typeof W.Profiler !== 'function') return false; const header = (await W.fetch(W.location.href, { cache: 'no-store' })).headers.get('document-policy'); if (header === null || !/js-profiling/.test(header)) throw new Error('expected the v147 route to serve document-policy: js-profiling, got ' + JSON.stringify(header)); const p = new W.Profiler({ sampleInterval: 10, maxBufferSize: 1000 }); const trace = await p.stop(); if (!Array.isArray(trace.samples) || !Array.isArray(trace.frames) || !Array.isArray(trace.stacks)) return false; const ok = trace.samples.every((s) => typeof s.timestamp === 'number' && (s.stackId === undefined || (Number.isInteger(s.stackId) && s.stackId >= 0 && s.stackId < trace.stacks.length))); return ok; } finally { /* keep the hidden frame attached: detaching it makes Chrome log an ERR_ABORTED for the frame's document, which the site's clean-network gates would count as a failure */ } })()

assertions.description: On a document served WITHOUT Document-Policy: js-profiling, new Profiler(...) must throw (Chrome: NotAllowedError DOMException 'JS profiling is disabled by Document Policy.').
assertions.test: Not run automatically: attempting the construction emits a browser 'Document policy violation' console entry on every page load, which this site's zero-console-error gates treat as a page failure. The contract is exercised for real, on demand, by the policy-and-marker-probe concept — its constructor button performs this exact call on this header-less route and surfaces the exact DOMException (verified: NotAllowedError, 'Failed to construct Profiler: JS profiling is disabled by Document Policy.').

assertions.description: Every marker value that appears in a real trace is one of the ProfilerMarker enum values: script, gc, style, layout, paint, other.
assertions.test: Not run automatically here: producing marker-bearing samples requires the Document-Policy: js-profiling header on the profiled document, the JSSelfProfilingMarkers origin trial or --enable-blink-features=ExperimentalJSProfilerMarkers, AND crossOriginIsolated === true (COOP+COEP, which this site does not serve anywhere). No trace may be fabricated to fake this check.

assertions.description: The marker member is [CrossOriginIsolated]: on a page where crossOriginIsolated is false, no sample in a real trace carries a marker member even when profiling itself runs.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: verifying this needs a marker-capable build (153 origin trial or the ExperimentalJSProfilerMarkers flag) profiling on a policy-enabled, non-isolated route; the current environment cannot distinguish 'markers gated by isolation' from 'markers not implemented', so the contract stays blocked rather than fake-passed.
